title: Workshop: build a trail directory
summary: Turn the plain mentions on a park directory page into real links: relative and absolute, in a new tab, within the page, to another page's section, and to email, phone and a file.
intro: a small directory page for a park. At the start it has headings and paragraphs, but no links, so every mention of another page is plain text. One link at a time, you will add a relative page link, a link into a folder, an external link that opens in a new tab, ids and jump links within the page, a link to another page's section, clearer link text, and links for email, phone and a file download. Keep the preview open and check each link's address.
